description: Checks an OpenAPI description or an MCP server's tool list for what AI agents need from a financial API: amounts with their currency and unit and not floats, times with a time zone, identifiers naming their standard (ISO 4217, ISO 3166, ISIN, LEI, BIC, IBAN), described operations and parameters, errors and rate limits, idempotency keys on calls that move money, and tools that trade or pay marked destructive. Suggests ISO 20022 names. Give the JSON as spec, or a url to an OpenAPI JSON, or mcp_url to read a remote MCP server's tools/list (no tool is called). Same code as https://iomarkets.tech/agent-ready.

mcp_url.description: A remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP), such as https://example.com/mcp.

spec.description: The OpenAPI description (JSON) or an MCP tools/list result, as text.

url.description: Where the OpenAPI JSON is, such as https://api.example.com/openapi.json.

name: check_agent_readiness
title: Is this financial API ready for AI agents?
